name: Wrap Existing Google Maps Scraper as Callable Subworkflow
purpose: Convert the existing Google Maps scraper into a reusable callable sub-workflow.

required_node.name: 3.1.1.1 - Execute Workflow Trigger
required_node.purpose: Receive execution requests and input parameters from the Master Orchestrator or another parent workflow.

target_flow.before: Existing Google Maps scraper runs through its current trigger/direct entry.
target_flow.after: Execute Workflow Trigger -> existing Google Maps scraper logic -> output
target_flow.rule: Preserve the existing scraper logic; only make its entry point callable.

input_contract.note: 3.1.1.2 is responsible for the explicit input-parameter node.

integration_rules: Do not remove the existing scraping logic.
Do not add normalization in this step.
Do not add error handling in this step.
Do not hard-code a search query or location.
Keep the workflow reusable by the Master Orchestrator.

validation.expected: Execute Workflow Trigger receives the execution.
Input is available to downstream scraper nodes.
Do not silently invent search parameters; validation belongs to the input-parameter step.

integration.next_purpose: Add input-parameter node for search query and location.

source_gap.reason: The plan specifies wrapping the existing scraper but does not identify its current trigger/node IDs.
source_gap.action: Apply the trigger to the actual existing Google Maps scraper workflow rather than creating a replacement scraper.

name: Google Maps Input Parameters
purpose: Define and validate the search query and location received by the callable Google Maps scraper.
rules: Do not hard-code the search query.
Do not perform scraping in this node.
validation: Trim whitespace before passing values downstream.

source_gap.reason: Source specifies search query/location but does not specify additional scraper-specific parameters.
source_gap.action: Preserve only parameters actually supported by the existing Google Maps scraper.

name: Normalize Google Maps Scraper Output
purpose: Convert Google Maps scraper results into the common outbound-lead schema.
rules: Every output item must follow the common schema.
Missing optional contact fields become null.
Do not invent missing contact information.
Do not enrich leads in this step.
Do not perform deduplication in this step.

validation.expected: All common-schema fields populated where available.
Each result becomes one normalized item.

source_gap.reason: Source defines the target common schema but not the exact field names emitted by the existing scraper.
source_gap.action: Map the actual scraper fields to the five common fields before production use.

name: Google Maps Scraper Error Handling
purpose: Handle zero-result searches and Google Maps/API failures without silently producing invalid lead data.

nodes.name: 3.1.1.4 - Results Available?
nodes.purpose: Detect whether scraper returned usable results.

zero_results_output.message: No Google Maps results found for the supplied search query and location.

rules: Do not convert zero results into fake lead records.
Do not silently treat API failures as successful empty results.
Do not retry indefinitely in this step.

source_gap.reason: Source only specifies 0-results/API-fail handling and does not define retry count, alert channel, or exact upstream error format.
source_gap.action: Connect this branch to the existing project-wide error/alert convention when integrating.
